news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders to build out its U.S. go-to-market team ahead of a planned NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in Q4 2026. The hires signal the company is preparing to commercialize independently rather than solely relying on a partner.

news.headline: Abivax re-engages Centerview amid renewed takeover interest
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported Abivax has re-engaged bank Centerview as takeover speculation resurfaced, with some analysts modeling a deal as large as $23 billion. No formal offer or process has been confirmed.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics Announces Development Collaboration with Abivax
news.summary: Valerio Therapeutics signed a binding term sheet for an exclusive worldwide R&D collaboration with Abivax to design next-generation candidates for immune-mediated inflammatory disease, using Abivax's disease expertise and Valerio's targeting platform. Valerio would receive an upfront payment of up to about EUR2.4 million plus future milestones and royalties once a definitive agreement is executed.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the freshly raised $920 million gives Abivax the option to launch obefazimod in the U.S. on its own rather than needing a Big Pharma partner or acquirer. The comments came amid persistent takeover speculation around the company.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized ADS offering, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $920 million. Proceeds are earmarked for U.S. commercialization of obefazimod and continued clinical development in UC and Crohn's disease.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 data showed obefazimod produced meaningful clinical and endoscopic remission in a highly refractory UC population, and that dose escalation to 50mg could recapture remission after relapse. Safety data, including malignancy rates, remained consistent with expected UC background rates, reinforcing the drug's benefit-risk profile.

catalysts.label: FDA pre-NDA meeting
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to meet with the FDA today to discuss the New Drug Application package for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis; outcome/minutes typically inform final filing details and are expected to be communicated by the company in the days following the meeting.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for submitting the NDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis to the FDA in late Q4 2026, following the pre-NDA meeting.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists H1 2026 results reporting for this date, which should also include an operational/program update.

catalysts.label: Potential M&A / takeover resolution
catalysts.detail: Persistent takeover speculation (Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca reported interest earlier in 2026; Centerview re-engaged in mid-July) continues, but no formal offer has been confirmed by the company.

pulse: Abivax remains in strong momentum: positive Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data in June enabled a $920 million financing round, and the company is now staffing up a U.S. commercial organization and signing smaller R&D deals (e.g., the July 16 Valerio Therapeutics collaboration) ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis. The FDA pre-NDA meeting is taking place today (2026-07-30), with the outcome expected to shape final NDA timing and be closely watched by investors, while renewed takeover speculation (Centerview re-engaged mid-July) keeps M&A optionality alive even as management publicly emphasizes a path to independent U.S. launch. Analyst sentiment has turned increasingly bullish, with Morgan Stanley and Piper Sandler both raising price targets into the $175-180 range following the data and financing, and the stock trading in the $125-145 range in recent weeks.
